units.source_text: 用活泼的笔致写在一张红纸上，夹在小公子的怀纸里，催他即速送去。

en.t: She wrote it in a lively hand on a sheet of red paper, slipped it into the young lord's folded paper, and urged him to deliver it at once.

units.source_text: 小公子的童心也非常亲近匂皇子，立刻就入宫去了。

en.t: The young lord, in his childlike heart, was also very fond of Prince Niou, and he immediately went into the palace.
